name: AutoML-Price-Forecasting-Benchmark
description: Price forecasting for used construction equipment is a challenging task due to spatial and temporal price fluctuations. It is thus of high interest to automate the forecasting process based on current market data. Even though applying machine learning (ML) to these data represents a promising approach to predict the residual value of certain tools, it is hard to implement for small and medium-sized enterprises due to their insufficient ML expertise. To this end, we demonstrate the possibility of substituting manually created ML pipelines with automated machine learning (AutoML) solutions, which automatically generate the underlying pipelines. We combine AutoML methods with the domain knowledge of the companies. Based on the CRISP-DM process, we split the manual ML pipeline into a machine learning and non-machine learning part. To take all complex industrial requirements into account and to demonstrate the applicability of our new approach, we designed a novel metric named method evaluation score, which incorporates the most important technical and non-technical metrics for quality and usability. Based on this metric, we show in a case study for the industrial use case of price forecasting, that domain knowledge combined with AutoML can weaken the dependence on ML experts for innovative small and medium-sized enterprises which are interested in conducting such solutions.
evaluation_method: composite_score (proposed Method Evaluation Score); secondary metrics: MAE / RMSE
general_score_metric: Method Evaluation Score (composite of technical and usability metrics)
reputation: A niche industrial AutoML case-study from 2304.14735 demonstrating a composite evaluation metric; limited widespread adoption beyond the study.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark on a small/industrial dataset; introduces a novel composite metric combining technical and non-technical criteria which complicates direct comparison to standard regression metrics; results sensitive to domain-specific feature engineering and AutoML configuration.
